business_object_attributes.note: Client-specific attributes. Exists in the current database.

my_tasks: assigned_user_id = signed-in user (literal integer, not a bind placeholder)
rules.other_tasks: department/sub-department task pool via task_department / task_sub_department
rules.delayed_task: task_sla_status = 'Delayed' (view has already compared task_elapsed_hours to task_sla_hours)
rules.client_due_date: use Business Object client due-date field

business_object_status.note: already text in the flat view; filter on the text, not on 1/2/80

business_object_color.note: already a colour name in the flat view

rules.dates: flat-view date columns are timestamptz, already converted from epoch
rules.task_status_case: task_status is lowercase; task_display_status is capitalised
